explication: BepInEx is a cross-runtime plugin and modding framework. A game starts a platform-specific preloader, which prepares assemblies and patches them where needed, then a chainloader discovers plugins, resolves dependencies, and initializes them. Plugins use shared configuration and logging services, while Unity adapters expose engine facilities such as input. IL2CPP additionally generates interop assemblies from native metadata and Unity libraries. The excerpts directly confirm launcher, patching context, chainloading, configuration, console, logging, and IL2CPP generation; some runtime handoffs are inferred from explicit entrypoint names.
